entries.description: The miner child exited, for any reason code; the autopilot relaunches it under backoff.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py run(), miner exit detected (site S2)
entries.name: MINER_EXITED

entries.description: The evidence log went stale past the hung window (the job stream stopped: a wedged miner, or a dead upstream presenting as silence); the autopilot kills the miner.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py run(), stale evidence kill (site S3)
entries.name: MINER_STALE_EVIDENCE

entries.description: The autopilot (re)started the miner child. A recovery action.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py start_child() (site S1)
entries.name: MINER_STARTED

entries.description: The autopilot process started and took the single-instance lock.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py main(), startup line (site S6)
entries.name: SUPERVISOR_STARTED

entries.description: The autopilot ended its run loop and shut down.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py run(), final line (site S5)
entries.name: SUPERVISOR_STOPPED

entries.description: The stop file was present; shutdown was requested through the operator path.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py run(), stop file check (site S4)
entries.name: OPERATOR_STOP

entries.description: A second autopilot starter was refused because the single-instance lock is held.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py main(), lock refusal print (site S7)
entries.name: INSTANCE_REFUSED

entries.description: The outer keeper found the autopilot dead and restarted it. Recorded by the keeper, which is not repo code; no repo emission site in this change.
entries.emission: registry only (keeper records)
entries.name: SUPERVISOR_LOST

entries.description: Self-update found a newer version on origin and started the pull.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py maybe_update() (site S8)
entries.name: UPDATE_AVAILABLE

entries.description: The update pull failed; the current version keeps mining.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py maybe_update() (site S9)
entries.name: UPDATE_PULL_FAILED

entries.description: New code failed the smoke test and was rolled back: a refusal of the new code.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py maybe_update() (site S10)
entries.name: UPDATE_REFUSED

entries.description: The update pulled, passed the smoke test, and the miner was restarted onto the new code. A recovery action.
entries.emission: mining/autopilot.py maybe_update() (site S11)
entries.name: UPDATE_APPLIED

entries.description: A coordinator or aggregation report was rejected as stale.
entries.emission: statistics keying K1: mining/mining_statistics.py record() of category stale_reports
entries.name: REPORT_STALE

entries.description: A coordinator or aggregation report was rejected as a duplicate delivery.
entries.emission: statistics keying K2: mining/mining_statistics.py record() of category duplicate_deliveries
entries.name: REPORT_DUPLICATE

entries.description: A work lease was abandoned without completion.
entries.emission: statistics keying K3: mining/mining_statistics.py record() of category leases_abandoned
entries.name: WORK_ABANDONED

entries.description: The pool rejected a submitted share (submission failure).
entries.emission: registry only in this change; producer is the miner evidence event share_result with accepted=false
entries.name: SHARE_REJECTED

entries.description: The upstream (pool connection or node) failed, closed or was unreachable, and its recovery. Covers the miner evidence events connection_error and reconnect_failed, their connected/reconnected recovery side, and the keeper's node-down records.
entries.emission: registry only in this change; producers are the miner evidence log and the keeper records
entries.name: UPSTREAM_DISCONNECT

entries.description: A backend tier was refused at probe or selection time. Exercised by the EXP-039 guarded probes and dispatch reason strings; the operational evidence corpus records selections only, so this class has no instance there.
entries.emission: registry only in this change; no operational producer wired
entries.name: BACKEND_REFUSED

entries.description: Independent candidate verification refused a candidate (hash mismatch or target failure).
entries.emission: registry only in this change; producer is the miner evidence event candidate_rejected
entries.name: CANDIDATE_REFUSED

entries.description: Template validation refused a template.
entries.emission: registry only in this change; producer is the miner evidence event template_rejected
entries.name: TEMPLATE_REFUSED

policy: Append-only. A code, once shipped, keeps its number, name and meaning forever; codes are never reused, renamed or redefined. New fault classes are appended with a new code in their group. Enforced by mining/incident_codes.py check_append_only and pinned by tests/test_incident_codes.py.
